text:
Dana Lo: We need to lock env var naming + config layering for templates v1 (py/ts/go) before we keep shipping READMEs. Right now we have `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in some places, `RW_API_KEY` in others, plus `MODEL` vs `REDWOOD_MODEL`.

Dana Lo: Proposal: one contract across languages. Prefix Redwood-specific with `REDWOOD_`, keep OTEL standard vars as-is (`OTEL_*`). For app/template knobs use `APP_` where it makes sense (port/log level). Thoughts?

Monica Patel: +1 on `REDWOOD_` prefix. It’s explicit and matches what people expect when they grep. Please no `RW_`—too ambiguous and we’ll regret it when docs land.

Ibrahim Khan: Agree. Also can we make sure we don’t do nested env like `REDWOOD__CLIENT__TIMEOUT` etc? That pattern gets messy across languages.

Wei Chen: From docs perspective, `REDWOOD_` is clearest. Also want consistent names for:
- base url
- model
- route/policy
- timeouts/retries
If we have to explain per-language differences we’ll lose the “<15 min” goal.

Sean Gallagher: SRE preference:
1) sane defaults in code
2) env vars override
3) minimal config file story (optional) so users don’t end up with 3 sources of truth
Also please standardize timeouts as *_MS (integers). Seconds vs ms mismatches are a huge ticket driver.

Marcus Lin: Security note: `.env` is fine for local dev, but templates should treat it as dev-only and have `.env.example` checked in (no secrets). Also ensure the docs say “don’t commit `.env`” and pre-commit/CI secret scanning catches it.

Connor O'Brien: On layering: our shared config loader can support (defaults < config file < env). But we should pick ONE config filename and one place.
Suggestion:
- optional `config/local.yaml` for dev overrides
- no implicit config file loading in prod (only if explicitly set)
But I’m fine w/ env-only too.

Sahana Iyer: CI angle: env-only is easiest for smoke tests, but having an optional config file doesn’t break anything if it’s truly optional. Just keep precedence deterministic.

Dana Lo: Ok let’s decide now and I’ll update the template contract doc + open a PR to normalize READMEs.

Dana Lo: Decision draft (please +1 / edits):

Env var naming (contract v1)
- Redwood API:
  - `REDWOOD_API_KEY`
  - `REDWOOD_BASE_URL` (default: https://api.redwoodinference.com)
  - `REDWOOD_MODEL` (default per template README)
  - `REDWOOD_ROUTE` (optional; maps to Console routing/fallback policies)
- Request behavior:
  - `REDWOOD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` (end-to-end request timeout)
  - `REDWOOD_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS` (optional; SDK/client connect timeout)
  - `REDWOOD_MAX_RETRIES` (default 2)
  - `REDWOOD_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` (cap for exponential backoff)
- Observability (don’t rename): use OpenTelemetry standard `OTEL_*` vars + `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`
- App-level:
  - `APP_ENV` (local/staging/prod)
  - `LOG_LEVEL` (debug/info/warn/error)
  - `PORT`

Config layering
- Precedence: code defaults < optional config file < env vars
- Optional config file path: `CONFIG_PATH` (if unset, no file is loaded)
- `.env` supported for local dev only (loaded when `APP_ENV=local`, if present)

No nested env vars / no language-specific aliases.

(reactions: :eyes: x3)

Monica Patel: +1. Minor: I’d drop `REDWOOD_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS` unless we actually use it in both SDKs. If it’s optional but not wired everywhere, it becomes docs drift.

Ibrahim Khan: +1 on everything else. Re: `REDWOOD_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS`—agree w/ Monica. Keep contract minimal.

Sean Gallagher: +1. Also can we clarify in docs that timeouts apply to streaming too (or at least to “time-to-first-byte”)? Users behind proxies will ask.

Wei Chen: +1. I’ll update the docs templates to reference `REDWOOD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` and add a short callout on streaming + proxies (plus link to SDK guidance once Monica confirms).

Marcus Lin: +1. Please add explicit note: don’t log `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and don’t log full prompts/responses by default. Even “debug mode” shouldn’t dump raw content unless user opts in.

Connor O'Brien: +1 on precedence + `CONFIG_PATH`. That’s clean.

Sahana Iyer: +1. For CI, env-only still works. If `CONFIG_PATH` is unset we’re deterministic.

Dana Lo: Great. Locking changes:
- Remove `REDWOOD_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS` from contract v1 (we can add later if we standardize it across SDKs)
- Add doc note: `REDWOOD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` is the overall request timeout (including streaming). Streaming examples should set a higher timeout and have retry guidance.
- Add security note: no prompt/response logging by default; require explicit `LOG_LLM_CONTENT=true` (or similar) if we ever add it.

Dana Lo: Action items:
- Dana: PR to normalize env var names across TS + Python templates + `.env.example` (today)
- Wei/Elliot: update docs copy to match contract and add config layering section (tomorrow)
- Monica/Ibrahim: confirm SDK helper uses `REDWOOD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` consistently + update examples (this week)

(reactions: :thumbsup: x6)

Elliot Price: +1. Please also add a short “Config sources” box in each README (defaults / CONFIG_PATH / env vars) so it’s consistent and skimmable.

Dana Lo: Will do. I’ll also drop a note in `template-structure-brainstorm` doc linking to this decision + the contract section.

Dana Lo: Closing the loop: I’ll treat this thread as the decision record unless someone objects by EOD.

(reactions: :white_check_mark: x4)
